blocks.title: What {{ Your Agents }} Can Do
blocks.description: Capabilities businesses configure across customer-facing, hiring, and internal workflows.

items.title: Inbound Lead Capture & Qualification
items.description: Every inquiry answered across voice, SMS, WhatsApp, web, and email — screened against your criteria and routed or booked without staff involvement.

items.title: Appointment Booking & Scheduling
items.description: Live calendar booking on your dispatch, CRM, or scheduling tool — confirmed, reminded, and rescheduled without back-and-forth.

items.title: Quote & Estimate Handling
items.description: Discloses pricing, captures financing interest, runs multi-touch quote follow-up, and routes complex requests to the right person.

items.title: Customer Service & Case Resolution
items.description: Opens, triages, and resolves support requests across every channel — pulling live data, executing fixes, and logging outcomes inside your tools.

items.title: Status & Order Updates
items.description: Answers status requests by reading live data from your CRM, ERP, dispatch, or order management system.

items.title: Follow-Up & Re-Engagement
items.description: Outbound conversations on renewals, abandoned inquiries, lapsed accounts, and pending quotes — returned to your team only when human judgment is needed.
